headlines.headline: Russell 2000 Closes Above 2,900 for First Time Since 2021 — Breakout Confirmed
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive technical — break above 2021 peak 2,900 triggered momentum chasing and FOMO; 3,000 magnet explains why IWM could grind to 3,068 despite overbought.

headlines.headline: Fed Holds at 3.50–3.75% Again — Waller/Daly Hint September Cut if Inflation Holds
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive — hold with dovish dissent kept cut hope alive; for IWM's floating-rate balance sheets, any hint of cut is direct earnings relief vs QQQ's fixed-rate fortress.
